## Why This Is Asked

This tests end-to-end coverage for real-time cross-region chat at scale, including partition tolerance and causal consistency, which are critical in services like Discord.

## Key Concepts

- Multi-region E2E orchestration
- Presence, edits, deletions, reactions
- Network partitions and reconciliations
- Causal ordering (Lamport/vector clocks)
- Data seeding and per-region isolation
